name: wrap-up-project
title: Wrap up a project
description: Goes through every open task and waiting handoff with you (complete, drop, move, or keep), then archives the project where it is.
say: We're done with the website redo.

note_exit.1: tasks or handoffs are still undecided

steps.title: Settle every open task and waiting handoff
steps.prompt: The project {{inputs.project}} is being wrapped up. What is still open is listed in: {{steps.open_items.output.text}}. Go through every open task and every waiting handoff with the person, one at a time: complete it, drop it with a reason, move it to another project, or keep it (shelved). Use /gt:gt-complete for each one. Do not archive anything yet.

steps.title: Check nothing is left undecided
steps.message: Look at what was settled. Say done when you are happy to archive the project (nothing is deleted).

steps.title: Archive the project where it is
steps.prompt: The person has agreed to archive {{inputs.project}}. Use /gt:gt-complete to archive it in place and offer to graduate what it learned into the wiki.
